title: REQ · Old RoundBadge and Countdown usage is removed from the App layout
summary: App no longer renders RoundBadge or Countdown directly.
description: Context: App renders RoundBadge and Countdown inside the scene slot, duplicating the header. Desired behavior: remove those imports and JSX from App. Expected result: round status and countdown appear only once, in the header. Why: avoid duplicate round UI.
acceptance_criteria: Given the playing view, then exactly one element shows the round status and one countdown, both within the header.
Given the source of App.tsx, then it does not import RoundBadge or Countdown.
definition_of_done: No RoundBadge or Countdown in App
